principle.name: SLOPE_NORMAL_TANGENTIAL_SPLIT_DEBT
principle.statement: A fixed inclined support may kill the landing's normal velocity while preserving downhill tangential momentum; support acquisition therefore creates slide, second-catch, brake, overshoot, rebound, and displaced-settle debt rather than an instant stop.

representation_note: The tracked contact-sheet remains a complete literal aligned authored-key sheet. The SPA reconstructs its selectable ASCII surface deterministically from the exact current motion/build data; motion.json is the persisted structured authority.

tango.finding: lead-toe normal catch is separated and costly; downhill tangent survives through crush/slide; late second catch, brake, overshoot, rebound and displaced settle read causally

noodle_queen.basis: same actual render plus full specimen
noodle_queen.finding: slope changes the force decomposition and recovery debt rather than acting as decoration; silhouette progression is specific and non-placeholder

validator.scope: candidate-isolated exact structural predicates at Standard Chat boundary
